summary: The change adds a payee lookup and an account_number field to the error-path log in deliver_statement (service.py). The primary risk is LOG-1 (NPI in logs), but the AppLog masking mechanism is validated by multiple passing unit tests (test_npi_fields_are_masked, test_app_log_writes_masked_lines) and the sample control test, and account_number is in the NPI field registry, so the value will be masked at log time. All process obligations (ticket, independent approval by a different change_approver, CI on the final commit with all control tests passing) are satisfied. No security_sensitive component or protected path is touched, and no previously accepted evidence is lapsed. The change is accepted.
